name: forma
description: Turn a screenshot, a PDF, or an existing report into a real DevExpress .repx — AI-generated spec, in-browser mockup, and XtraReports XML. Bring your own Gemini key.
comment:overrides: qs: two Dependabot advisories (array-limit bypass, DoS via attacker-controlled isBuffer) are fixed in 6.16.0, but no direct dependency asks for it -- the vulnerable copy arrives via @google/genai -> @modelcontextprotocol/sdk -> express@5. `npm audit fix` cannot reach it without a breaking change, so it is pinned here instead. Every qs in the tree was already 6.x, so this is a patch-level lift, not a major. Remove this entry once the chain ships 6.16.0 on its own; `npm ls qs --all` shows whether it still bites.
comment:not-overridden: @grpc/grpc-js, uuid and @opentelemetry/core carry open Dependabot advisories and are deliberately NOT overridden. @grpc/grpc-js (two highs, fixed in 1.13.6) is pinned ~1.9.0 by @firebase/firestore, in 4.14.0 and still in 4.17.2, so no firebase release in range fixes it, and an override would push another package's internals four minors past the range it asked for. It is Firestore's Node.js transport -- the browser entry never imports it -- so here it runs only in the rules tests, against the local emulator. It is also the whole reason firebase, both Firestore packages and @firebase/rules-unit-testing are flagged high. uuid (9.0.1 via gaxios -> 11.1.1) and @opentelemetry/core (1.30.1 via @google-cloud/pubsub -> 2.8.0) live inside firebase-tools, already the latest published version (15.34.1 as of 2026-10-24), so the fix has to come from upstream. That is how csv-parse and stream-json closed: they were listed here until 15.34.1 bumped them itself. Forcing a major into firebase-tools is a different proposition from the patch-level qs lift above, because it runs the Firestore emulator that `npm run test:rules` depends on, and breaking it takes 70 security-rule tests with it. Leave the alerts OPEN rather than dismissing them: an open alert closes itself when upstream bumps its dependencies, a dismissed one stays silent forever. Re-check with `npm ls @grpc/grpc-js uuid @opentelemetry/core --all` before acting on this.
